query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, c.setName,
       COUNT(ph.id) as psa10Count,
       AVG(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as psa10AvgPrice,
       MIN(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as psa10MinPrice,
       MAX(CAST(ph.price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as psa10MaxPrice,
       MIN(ph.soldAt) as earliestDate,
       MAX(ph.soldAt) as latestDate
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN priceHistory ph ON c.id = ph.cardId 
  AND ph.source = 'snkrdunk' 
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
WHERE c.cardNumber LIKE '%068/049%'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.nameJa, c.cardNumber, c.setName;
